text:
maria: Trying the docker quickstart with GitHub OIDC (workload identity) and my first POST to /v1/chat returns 401 then 403 billing: workspace_unprovisioned. Quickstart shows workspace as provisioned in the console. Anyone seen OIDC + container weirdness?

maria: gist of logs:```
2026-03-23T09:02:10Z auth: validated oidc token sub=repo:acme/app:ref:refs/heads/main
2026-03-23T09:02:10Z caller=client.go status=401 msg="unauthorized: token missing org_claim"
2026-03-23T09:02:12Z caller=client.go status=403 msg="billing: workspace_unprovisioned"
```

patrick: are you using the sample container that mounts the token from the GH Actions runner or are you minting locally?

maria: mounting the token via volume from the runner. The token has `sub` and `aud` but GH OIDC tokens don't include an email by default.

sophie: same class of problem as we've seen with app-only flows - our provisioning service tries to map a caller to a workspace via org/email claim. OIDC flow often lacks email. We should accept org id via header `x-redwood-org` as a temporary route.

maria: adding header fixed it for me. Example:```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OIDC_TOKEN" \
  -H "x-redwood-org: org_02A9KQ" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

patrick: hmm, but quickstart container reads token from /var/run/secrets/… and doesn't set org header. For DX we should either: 1) update the quickstart to accept an env var REDWOOD_ORG and set the header for sample requests, or 2) change the runtime to fallback to org binding for OIDC service accounts.

sophie: open INF-4890 to track: "quickstart: support GH OIDC by honoring REDWOOD_ORG env or better mapping". assign devex.

maria: another wrinkle — the SDKs currently translate 401/403 in different ways. Node SDK throws a 401 with message "Unauthorized" while python returns a structured error with code "workspace_unprovisioned" which confuses onboarding scripts. SDK parity ticket?

patrick: yes, we have a backlog item. I'll link INF-4891 for SDK parity on auth/billing error codes. Right now onboarding guide suggests checking console billing toggle which is misleading for OIDC flows.

devex-bot: note: quickstart-image v0.8.7 deployed to staging at 2026-03-22T22:00:00Z - contains environment variable support but not yet published in docs.

maria: quick workaround steps I documented in the thread: 1) add REDWOOD_ORG env to container and set x-redwood-org on requests; 2) if using GH Actions, set `outputs.org` and inject header; 3) when possible use a user-scoped token for initial testing.

patrick: thanks — devex, can we get a short blurb added to the quickstart README and a small sample `docker run` that shows the env flag? I'll PR it.

sophie: and let's make the error text clearer: instead of generic workspace_unprovisioned return "missing org mapping: add x-redwood-org or provision org" so users hit a helpful next step.

maria: confirmed that after adding the header the sample app returned first-call success: 200 + stream start. :party_parrot:

cli-bot: reminder: please include the provider token type in bug reports (oidc/msal/service-account) — helps triage.

patrick: PR incoming for quickstart README and sample run command. Will link INF-4890/INF-4891 in PR.

maria: thanks all, saved me a ton of time. :thumbsup:
